question: Should outbound recovery keep no-adapter ambiguous send entries pending without retry-budget spend as the interim policy, or should those entries terminalize until the broader delivery ledger/reconciliation design exists?
rationale: The code path is coherent and prior review defects are fixed, but pending-versus-failed is an operator-visible policy choice for persisted queue state, future reconciliation, and message-delivery observability.

options.title: Accept Pending Deferral
options.body: Merge this as a narrow mitigation that prefers future reconciliation and recoverability over terminalizing ambiguous no-adapter entries.

options.title: Require Operator Boundaries
options.body: Ask for a bounded pending state, cleanup path, or visible operator surface before merge if long-lived queue rows are not acceptable.

options.title: Defer To Ledger Design
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers want the canonical delivery-ledger work to decide ambiguous recovery semantics in one place.

recommendation.title: Accept Pending Deferral
recommendation.body: Merge this as a narrow mitigation that prefers future reconciliation and recoverability over terminalizing ambiguous no-adapter entries.
